title: Closed subsets proper over a base; support of a module; modules with support proper over a base
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. (1) A closed subset $Z\subseteq X$ is *proper over $S$* if the morphism $Z\to X\to S$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] when $Z$ is given its reduced induced closed subscheme structure (the unique reduced closed subscheme of $X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] with underlying set $Z$). (2) For an $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] its *support* is $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)=\{x\in X:\mathcal F_x\neq0\}$, $\mathcal F_x$ the stalk [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. (3) $\mathcal F$ *has support proper over $S$* if $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$ is a closed subset of $X$ which is proper over $S$ in the sense of (1).

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Section 'Being proper over a base' (section-proper-over-base): Definition 0CYM (definition-proper-over-base) via condition (1) of Lemma 0CYL (lemma-closed-proper-over-base); the paragraph before Lemma 0CYS for 'the support of F is proper over S' (support closed by Morphisms Lemma 056J)
